author: pgaudet
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete 

GO:0051484 isopentenyl diphosphate biosynthetic process, methylerythritol 4-phosphate pathway involved in terpenoid biosynthetic process'
GO:2000526 positive regulation of glycoprotein biosynthetic process involved in immunological synapse formation'



see [[GO-ONTOLOGY TICKET]](https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31228)

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 

https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1--QYPtvO3ldRu9NlsRjbnMSs4miR7MFFMHOLfnXDT24/edit?gid=0#gid=0



Impacted groups: 
GO:2000526: 1 BHF annotation, but also annotations to individual terms (UniProtKB:P47774 & PMID:15845453
GO:0051484 : 3 ComplexPortal annotation,




Thanks.
